prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, tech stack and whether you need enterprise-level consulting or a small, nimble team. I can, however, help you find the best fit. Before that, here are quick guidelines and a short list of reputable LA options to consider.

How to pick the best agency for you
- Define goals: personalization, programmatic media, creative optimization, predictive LTV, chatbots, email automation, etc.  
- Check proof: case studies with measurable KPIs (lift in conversion, ROAS, retention).  
- Team mix: data scientists/ML engineers + growth marketers + creative directors.  
- Tech partnerships: CDP/CRM, cloud providers (AWS/GCP/Azure), ad platforms, creative-testing tools.  
- Data & privacy: clear approach to first-/zero-party data and compliance (CCPA/CPRA).  
- Pricing & transparency: how they measure success and report results.  
- Trial or pilot: low-risk pilot project before long-term engagement.

Examples of agencies to evaluate in/near Los Angeles
(choose by scale and focus)

- Global/Enterprise-level (AI + marketing practice): Accenture Song (Accenture Interactive), Deloitte Digital, Publicis Sapient — good for complex data integrations, enterprise personalization or CX programs.  
- Creative + tech hybrids with LA presence: R/GA, Ogilvy, VaynerMedia — strong on creative + data-driven campaigns and platform integrations.  
- Performance/digital specialists (LA-based or with LA offices): Wpromote, Tinuiti, Metric Theory — focused on paid media, programmatic, and data-driven growth using automation/ML.  
- Boutique AI/data-driven shops and consultancies: smaller local firms and consultancies that specialize in personalization, CDP implementation, ML models and experimentation — useful for startups or targeted pilots (I can shortlist these once I know your needs).

If you want, I can:
- Shortlist 4–6 LA agencies tailored to your budget, industry, and goals (with pros/cons and sample questions to ask them), or  
- Draft an RFP/pilot brief you can send to agencies.

Tell me: what’s your industry, monthly/annual marketing budget, and top 2–3 goals (e.g., increase ROAS, personalize site/email, automate creative testing, build an LTV model)?
